description: This file is a C header file defining API declarations related to D-Bus messaging for CCSP SnmpAgent PA, including functions for getting and setting parameters, managing instances, and component communication.

methods.name: Cosa_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the SnmpAgent PA subsystem.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds destination component name and path based on namespace.

methods.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from a specified component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_SetParamValuesNoCommit
methods.description: Sets parameter values without committing immediately.

methods.name: Cosa_GetInstanceNums
methods.description: Retrieves instance numbers for a given object.

methods.name: Cosa_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry from a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_FreeParamValues
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for parameter values.

methods.name: Cosa_BackgroundCommit
methods.description: Performs background commit or rollback of parameter changes.
